notes.value: Sold by XPeng Pakistan (Tesla Industries) since 23 January 2026. This row is the entry RWD Standard Range at PKR 14,500,000 ex-factory: 68.5 kWh battery, single rear motor 185 kW (248 hp) and 440 Nm, 0-100 km/h 6.94 s, 202 km/h, 480 km WLTP on 18-inch wheels (470 km on 20-inch), 16.6 kWh/100 km WLTP, 800V platform with DC 10-80% in 12 minutes, 11 kW AC (7.9 h full). The Standard Range lacks the Long Range's Nappa leather, front-seat massage, digital rear-view mirror and, per the brochure, the ACC/LCC/ATC/ALC assisted-driving functions. Other trims: RWD Long Range PKR 15,500,000 (80.8 kWh, 218 kW, 440 Nm, 6.7 s, 535 km WLTP) and AWD Performance PKR 18,500,000 (80.8 kWh, 358 kW, 660 Nm, 4.13 s, 510 km WLTP). 4,758 x 1,920 x 1,650 mm, 2,890 mm wheelbase, 571 L boot, kerb 2,025 kg (PakWheels), ground clearance 172 mm (PakNEV).
